★Request
Fade in

Bamboo Memory definitely has the aptitude for turf.
Even if she wants to switch over from dirt, there's no need to rush—she can take her time.

So I couldn't understand why she was fixated on
making the "next inter-school meet." I explained this to her.

Right across the fence from the dirt track we were standing on,
sprinting along the lush green turf, was—

Ah, gotcha! No worries, it's pretty simple!
You see—

Ah, you can tell, right?!
She's incredible! So fast, Oguri Cap-senpai!!

Oh, no no! My dad's a kendoka.
He teaches elementary school now too, but he's not a running specialist or anything!

Bamboo Memory had apparently been practicing on her own since early morning.
At her persistent urging, I ended up overseeing her training.
Like hell... I'll lose!

When I was little, I was pretty frail, and a total crybaby on top of that.
So my dad forged me into what I am today!
Because I have already met Bamboo Memory.

Yes sir!! I'll endure it and take it one step at a time!!
'Cause I'm gonna become strong just like you, Dad!!

The first time I saw her run, sparks flew!
I knew right then that she was my rival—

Even as the gap widened, Bamboo Memory never stopped,
powerfully running all the way through to the end.

He studied things outside his field just to train with me every single day.
I loved my dad so much for that. I've always looked up to him—

I woke up unusually early with nothing to do,
so I decided to just head into Tracen Academy early—and that's when it happened.

Whoa, look at the time!!
Sorry about that, Trainer! Back to training!!
Break through your limits!! Exploding Squats!!

If you don't mind, could you watch my morning practice?!
I know it's super sudden, but please!!

If you keep putting in steady effort like this—without fail!!
You'll stand on a fiery battlefield just like mine!

That's why I came to Tracen Academy!
To have a fiery showdown with the ultimate rival!
Haa... haa... damn it...!

That's the 'Blazing Passion Training'!!
How's that?! Pretty cool, right?!

That's why I gotta switch to turf! I want to run
in the meet's 1600m turf race that Oguri-senpai's entered in!!
A-And then?! What happens next?!

Now, next I'd like you to watch me run on turf...!
Whaddya say?! Trainer!!
Huh?! How'd you know that?!

In that moment, I understood that there was no stopping her.
Even if she seemed to be making steady, diligent efforts, her heart had already taken off sprinting.
Pump those muscles!! Galactica High Knees!!

—Still, I wanna fight. This burning feeling just won't stop.
'Cause I've already met her!!

Mm! You did well holding back your curiosity and pushing through!!
Patience is part of the training, too!

—My instructor recommended dirt out of concern for my hooves.
They're someone I trust, so I've been following their advice, but...!

Oh, glad you asked!! My basic training routine
was actually made by my dad!!

Just then, the promised shinai glowed with brilliant light—oops, break time's over!!
Passionate Training, second half, begin!
Yes sir!! By the way, right now it's—

Just as Bamboo Memory began to speak,
it felt as though a sudden gust of wind tore past behind her.

However, dirt makes it much harder to build speed compared to turf.
She was quickly left behind. Even so—
(WHOOSH...!)

UWOOOH!! Blazing Passion Training!!
Number Five!!

DEYAAAH!! Blazing Passion Training!!
Number Ten!!

DORYAAAA!! Blazing Passion Training!!
Number Fifteen—

I wanted to experience those fierce battles from my dad's heroic tales too—
that bond of friendship and rivalry!

I want to see the scenery she's gazing at together with her.
That feeling, too, is something I can no longer hold back.
...Hmph!

Blazing Passion Training, Number Ten... complete!
Haa... haa...!
My... rival!!

I wanna fight her! I wanna catch up to her!
I want to run on the exact same track as her right now!!

—And there, I was reunited with my former rival.
It was at the national championship finals!
—Oguri-senpai!
...I know it's destiny.

As if chasing after Oguri Cap on the turf,
Bamboo Memory took off running on the adjacent dirt track.

Man, my bad for sprinting off like that!
To tell you the truth, that senpai just now was—

By the time Bamboo Memory finished her entire basic routine,
the sun had risen, and other Umamusume were beginning to show up for morning practice.

Aahh!! You're the Trainer who was walking while distracted the other day!!
Are you free right now by any chance?!
